contracts.behavior: The shared right-click and Edit Copy section orders Copy, Copy as HTML, Copy All Scrollback and Copy All Scrollback as HTML consecutively; both full-scrollback actions have visible copy icons even with GTK menu images disabled and remain enabled without a selection
Copy All Scrollback copies plain text from the visible screen and retained offscreen history, including Unicode, without sending any input to the child

Copy All Scrollback as HTML offers HTML source via text targets and a UTF-16 text/html payload for rich-text destinations, preserving bold, colour, Unicode and escaped markup across the full retained buffer without sending input to the child

environments.automated_gui: Private HOME/XDG, Xvfb and session bus; real GTK menu actions, VTE buffer, PTY and clipboard targets
environments.native_wayland: Cross-application Wayland clipboard transfer is not covered by the Xvfb checks
